editorial.blurb: Deba Sushi Bar is an exciting new spot serving pristine, beautifully presented sushi with thoughtfully crafted rolls and a warm, polished atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the black rice nigiri and sashimi options like the Madai Orenji for a refreshing, elevated take on classics—and try the smoked scallop if available.

topDishes.note: Standout texture with fluffiness and slight chew that elevates the sushi experience
Exceptional quality, described as the best by reviewers
